note: DROPWATCH cross-family map (assembled 2026-07-07). Ordering axis is NOT model capability (non-monotone) but REPAIR-RETENTION: pin_oracle strict-min = how well the model holds a fact that is re-stated every hop. DROPWATCH's online targeting beats blanket fixed pinning EXACTLY when repairs stick (high oracle). This supersedes the premature 'monotone-with-capability' reading (falsified by gpt-5.4).
regime: M=24 mixed-type, K=16, budget=25, B_ri=4, theta=0.35, n=100, strict-min estimand, paired-over-facts bootstrap.
finding: The DROPWATCH advantage over a-priori fair pinning is monotone in repair-retention (oracle strict-min), not in capability. Precondition for the method: repaired facts must survive to the next hop. When forgetting is fast AND uniform (gpt-5.5), reactive repair is whack-a-mole and constant blanket pinning wins; oracle strict-min is a cheap pre-flight test of whether DROPWATCH will help.
honest_correction: An earlier 3-point reading (Qwen>mini>gpt-5.5) looked monotone-decreasing in capability; gpt-5.4 (full) PASSING at +0.291 falsifies that. Reporting the full pre-registered set (report-ALL rule, commit a079150) is what caught it.
cost_note: dropwatch/dropwatch_esc cost_per_hop = 3.75 < B_ri=4.0 on ALL four models -> event-driven quiescence is universal even where the accuracy gate fails.
